summary: Genius Group Ltd furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited H1 2026 results and a related press release. The company reported 140% revenue growth, $6.4 million net profit from operating units, a 79% reduction in total net loss to $4 million, and net assets of $106 million ($0.61 per share). It cited a completed restructure, 99% reduction in third-party debt, a vacated Second Circuit injunction, a $7,971,168.53 ICC award, and a board-approved $1.2 billion capital plan. This is a routine earnings filing, not a special situation.
